title: Relationships, Factions, Reputation & Party-Association Influence
objective: Add NPC/creature relationship, faction, reputation and party-association influence projections over authoritative owner-domain records without duplicating or mutating MIB-09 or other canonical relationship/social-state ledgers.

scope.purpose: Provide bounded social-context influence projections for NPC/creature authoring and runtime-facing proposals while retaining MIB-09 and related owner-domain authority.
scope.completion_gate: NPC/creature social-context influence can be projected from authoritative relationship/faction/reputation/party-association records without creating duplicate ledgers or mutating canonical social state.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MNCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.2.0 were reconsulted after exact-tree MNCS-06 publication.
The DAG contains no MNCS-06-triggered rotation or newly eligible unfinished interstitial that overrides MNCS strict order; MNCS-08 is the next unfinished surviving tranche.

MNCS-08 may project influence from authoritative social-state references but cannot create a second relationship, faction, reputation or party-association ledger.

MNCS-08 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue.
The independent ui-implementation lane remains UISR-05 selected_not_started and is preserved unchanged.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue in the product-development lane. On that command, governed-start MNCS-08 with the OPS3 execution guard; do not implement while selected_not_started.
